CONTAINS.description: A repository, package, or module contains a code or test artifact.

DEFINES.description: A file defines a module, class, or function.

IMPORTS.description: A file or module imports or directly depends on another code unit or package.

CALLS.description: A function, API, or worker invokes another function, API, worker, or external dependency.

TESTS.description: A test checks a module, file, class, function, API, or worker.

READS.description: A module, function, API, or worker reads data from a datastore.

WRITES.description: A module, function, API, or worker writes data to a datastore.

PUBLISHES.description: A module, function, API, or worker publishes messages to a queue.

CONSUMES.description: A module, function, API, or worker consumes messages from a queue.

DEPENDS_ON.description: A package, API, or worker requires an external dependency at runtime or build time.
